textbook_summary: Regular rapid SVT, typically normal QRS, P-prime may be hard to distinguish.

authored_choices.P_prime_vector: Negative one half of reference P electrode coefficients

limitations: Established fixed200bpm example, not onset/termination, AVNRT/AVRT diagnosis or reentry mechanism
No delta or separate sinus P; synchronous atrial/ventricular grid is authored
Both demos share the source; bounded overlap integration is documented in svt-perfusion.json
No inference of ejection strength or hemodynamic compensation
